description: This file contains test cases for a proxy system handling chat completion requests, focusing on fallback mechanisms, retries, timeout handling, and interaction with external services such as OpenAI. It uses pytest with asyncio, and tests various scenarios and edge cases for the chat completion API.

methods.name: generate_key( session, i, models: list, calling_key="sk-1234", )
methods.description: Generates an API key with assigned models via a POST request to /key/generate.

methods.name: chat_completion( session, key: str, model: str, messages: list, return_headers: bool = False, extra_headers: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Makes a POST request to /chat/completions with specified messages and parameters, handling headers and response parsing.

methods.name: test_chat_completion()
methods.description: Tests chat completion with a large text prompt to ensure fallback works as expected.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_client_fallbacks(has_access)
methods.description: Tests fallback mechanism when client lacks access to a model, verifying proper failure handling.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_retries()
methods.description: Tests retry logic and header response for rate limiting or error simulation.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_fallbacks()
methods.description: Tests fallback requests with alternate models, verifying fallback headers.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_timeout()
methods.description: Checks timeout handling with low timeout settings and mock timeout indicator.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_with_timeout_from_request()
methods.description: Tests timeout behavior when timeout specified via headers.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_client_fallbacks_with_custom_message(has_access)
methods.description: Tests fallback with custom message payloads.

methods.name: bool make_request(client: AsyncOpenAI, model: str)
methods.description: Sends a chat completion request via AsyncOpenAI client, returning success status.

methods.name: bool run_good_model_test(client: AsyncOpenAI, num_requests: int)
methods.description: Runs multiple requests to a known good model, verifying all succeed.

ctags.name: chat_completion
ctags.signature: ( session, key: str, model: str, messages: list, return_headers: bool = False, extra_headers: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )

ctags.name: make_request
ctags.pattern: /^async def make_request(client: AsyncOpenAI, model: str) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: run_good_model_test
ctags.pattern: /^async def run_good_model_test(client: AsyncOpenAI, num_requests: int) -> bool:$/
